KEY        ID        PERMS OWNER SIZE NATTCH STATUS CTIME   CPID LPID COMMAND
The KEY column is the key the segment was created with, in hexadecimal,
and ID is the identifier shmget returned. SIZE is rounded to a unit
unless --bytes is given. NATTCH counts the attached processes, STATUS
says dest or locked when either applies, and CTIME is when the segment
last changed. CPID and LPID are the creator and the last user, and
COMMAND is the creator's command line when it is still running.
